Components/Overlays

Dialog also Modal

ray-ds's modal, on the native <dialog>: top layer, the rest of the page inert, focus trapped and restored, stackable. Title, description, header, body and footer; preset or free sizes. Also exports confirmDialog().

The modal
ray-dialog is the modal of ray-ds Backdrop, inert page, trapped and restored focus, Escape, stacking. This one takes 70% of the window (size="70%" height="70%") and holds a whole settings screen: vertical tabs, fields, a table, sliders, switches and a confirmation stacked on top.

API

<ray-dialog> · RayDialog

Any slotted element with data-dialog-close closes it (its value becomes returnValue). JS: show(), close(returnValue), confirmDialog({ label, message, confirmLabel, cancelLabel, color }) -> Promise<boolean>.

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
openopen reflectsbooleanShown as a modal.
labellabelstringHeading (also the dialog's accessible name).
descriptiondescriptionstringA line under the title (the dialog's accessible description).
sizesize reflectsstringmdWidth: xs…xl, full (the whole window), or any CSS length; a percentage is of the window (70% = 70vw, at least 40rem). Never wider than the window.
heightheight reflectsstringFixed height (the body scrolls): any CSS length; a percentage is of the window (70% = 70dvh, at least 30rem). Never taller than the window. Default: as tall as the content, up to the window.
radiusradius reflectsstringCorner radius: xs…xl, none, or a CSS length. Default: lg.
positionposition reflectscenter | topcenterVertical placement.
persistentpersistent reflectsbooleanEscape and backdrop clicks do not close it (the × still does; hide it with hide-close). To allow only one of them, cancel ray-request-close by its source.
hideClosehide-close reflectsbooleanNo close button in the header.
overlayBluroverlay-blurstringBlur of the page behind: px ("8"), a CSS length or "none". Default: --ray-overlay-blur ([overlay] blur in tokens.toml).
EventDescription
ray-openAfter it opened.
ray-closeAfter it closed; detail: { returnValue }.
ray-request-closeEscape, backdrop or close button; cancelable (preventDefault keeps it open). detail: { source }.
SlotDescription
(default)Body.
headerExtra header content, next to the title.
footerActions, aligned to the end.
PartDescription
dialogThe native <dialog>.
titleThe heading.
descriptionThe line under the heading.
headerThe header: title, description, the header slot and the close button.
bodyThe scrollable body.
footerThe footer.
closeThe close button.
